subject: Expansion: Brightfield additional projects & keying plan
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice@brightfieldhealth.com>, procurement@brightfieldhealth.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-12T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Expansion: Brightfield additional projects & keying plan

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion, I've sketched a recommended rollout for the five new Brightfield projects you've outlined. Attached is a quote and a draft SOW that breaks pricing and timelines by phase.

High-level plan:
- Pilot (2 apps, sandbox keys) — 2 weeks to validate prompts and rate limits
- Phase 1 (3 apps, production keys) — staggered activation over 4 weeks
- Phase 2 (remaining projects) — scheduled after success metrics met

Key asks from our side:
1) Confirm the list of apps that will be in the pilot
2) Procurement point-of-contact for PO and SOW sign-off
3) Preferred date for a 30-minute kickoff to align on integration owners

Note on terms/pricing: to keep the unit economics predictable for you, we can extend your current annual term by 6 months in exchange for a 12% committed capacity discount on the additional app capacity. I've flagged line items in the quote.

Attachments: redwood-quote-BH-2028-06.pdf, SOW_additional_apps.xlsx

Available next week: Tue/Wed afternoon PT. Let me know what works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Alice Park <alice@brightfieldhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-12T18:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: Brightfield additional projects & keying plan

Hi Marcus,

Appreciate the plan — this looks like the right approach. A few quick clarifications:

- Can you break out per-app unit pricing (pilot vs prod) and show the incremental cost if we move apps from pilot to phase 1 early?
- We need each app to have a distinct API key/namespace for auditing — can Redwood do per-app keys scoped to a team?
- Procurement will want an estimated PO amount and the SOW line items. Procurement POC is samir.j@brightfieldhealth.com (cc'd here).
- Security: can you include a link to the current SOC 2 report and confirm KMS options for key wrapping?

We can do a kickoff on Wed 6/14 at 11:00 AM PT if that works for your team.

Thanks,
Alice
VP, Product
Brightfield Health
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice@brightfieldhealth.com>, Samir Joshi <samir.j@brightfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-13T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: Brightfield additional projects & keying plan

Hi Alice / Samir — thanks for the quick reply.

Short answers up front: yes to per-app keys (namespaced per team), yes to KMS options (we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure KeyVault), and SOC 2 link is below.

SOC 2 link: https://redwood-internal.s3.amazonaws.com/compliance/soc2-report-2027.pdf

Pricing summary (high level):
- Pilot (sandbox keys, no SLA): $0.0025 per token equivalent (metered). Estimated pilot run cost per app ~ $3,000 over 2 weeks depending on volume.
- Production (per-app prod key): $0.0018 per token equivalent with included caching optimizations. If you commit to an incremental capacity block for additional apps we can drop to $0.0016 per token equivalent (12% off) for the added consumption.

If you opt into the 6-month term extension we discussed, we'll apply a one-time credit that effectively phases in the discounted rate immediately (details in the attached quote).

Rollout / keys:
- We will create separate API keys per app and map them to team namespaces in the Console. Keys can be rotated independently, and usage is reported at the key level for cost/latency dashboards.
- For the pilot, we'll issue sandbox keys with relaxed throttles. Production keys will be applied per app during Phase 1 activation windows.

Operational ask for kickoff (Wed 6/14 11:00 AM PT): please share the pilot app list and the integration owner emails so we can include them in the calendar invite. I'll send a calendar invite momentarily.

I'll also push an updated SOW and a DocuSign envelope this afternoon that reflects the requested per-app line items and the proposed term extension.

Attachments: redwood-quote-BH-2028-06.pdf (updated pricing table)

DocuSign (draft): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-redwood-BH

Cheers,
Marcus
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-14T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Expansion: Brightfield additional projects & keying plan (internal planning)

Marcus / Ben — forwarding the thread with Alice. Quick internal notes before the kickoff: 

- Confirm Dedicated pool headroom: if they take discounted committed capacity, we need a 40% buffer for the first 8 weeks to avoid throttling incidents. Ops has flagged Q3 GPU availability but can prioritize this with a 2-week lead.
- Sales ops: prepare a single SOW with clear line items per app and the term extension clause (6 months). Include the credit schedule so Finance can book the revenue timing.
- CS: designate an enablement owner to run the pilot onboarding sessions (2x 60-minute deep dives).

I'll join the kickoff and own the enablement calendar. Marcus, can you confirm the pilot app names in the invite?

--Laura
From: procurement@brightfieldhealth.com <procurement@brightfieldhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Joshi <samir.j@brightfieldhealth.com>, Alice Park <alice@brightfieldhealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-15T10:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: Brightfield additional projects & keying plan / PO and next steps

Marcus,

Thanks — we reviewed the quote and are ready to move forward pending an updated SOW and a formal DocuSign link with the PO amount. Attached is a signed PO stub for internal reference (Brightfield_PO_stub.pdf).

Please include the SOC 2 link in the SOW and confirm the KMS flow for key wrapping. Also include billing cadence (monthly vs net 30) — Brightfield prefers net 30 invoicing.

Once we have the DocuSign envelope we will forward to our legal for countersign.

Regards,
Procurement Team
Brightfield Health
